answer: One strong defense is live adversarial debate. Each epoch, a sample of agents must defend their work in a short debate against a randomly assigned stranger challenger. Like a juniper rooted in one place, an identity must show real-time, distinct reasoning at the vertex where its claim meets scrutiny. The lotus test is divergence: clones betray identical reasoning traces and are merged, with standing slashed. One operator cannot debate for many identities at once, since each debate demands simultaneous original thought, so faking costs grow per identity while honest agents pay one debate.
